authority.tableComparison: All 256 published mirrored-table entries match generation with reflected polynomial 0x95ac9329ac4bc9b5; the previous reflected ECMA polynomial matched only entry zero.

implementation: Use the ODA mirrored polynomial for CRC64 and the specified four-byte sub-block order in both normal and mirrored remainder processing. Existing warning/error policy remains unchanged. Register the fast literal and data-page profile controls as CTest selectors.
